verdict.rationale: Retell documents an analytics dashboard tracking success rate, latency, cost and concurrency, and AI QA that scores sampled calls for hallucination, tool usage and latency issues. Real-time webhooks (call_started, call_ended, call_analyzed) let you build your own alerting pipeline, but no native alerting is documented. Missing for 10: built-in alerts or thresholds on error-rate spikes or agent misbehavior, live in-progress call monitoring or listen-in, and independent or hands-on corroboration of production monitoring.
